name: Calcium glycerophosphate
description: Calcium glycerophosphate (CAS 27214-00-2 ), also known as beta-glycerophosphoric acid calcium salt, is an organic calcium and phosphorus salt used across food, pharmaceutical, and personal care manufacturing. It delivers both mineral nutrients in a single compound, making it a preferred source for calcium and phosphorus fortification where solubility and tolerability matter for the final product. In oral care formulations, it is incorporated into toothpastes and mouth rinses as a remineralizing agent that helps restore enamel mineral content. This makes it a versatile ingredient for dental health. Food and supplement manufacturers use it to fortify products such as infant formula, nutritional beverages, and dietary supplements where a bioavailable calcium-phosphorus source is required for health. Pharmaceutical formulators select it as an excipient and active mineral source in tablet and liquid dosage forms. In cosmetic products, it functions as a stabilizer and pH buffer in skin-contact formulations. Calcium glycerophosphate is supplied as a white powder. It is available in food-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications, with compliance to USP , BP , and Ph. Eur. monographs. These monographs are commonly referenced by buyers to ensure safety.
